title: Phase C — unified LLM planning & deterministic-template removal across every new-Mission ingress
description: Phase C removes the deterministic task-template fallback from makeServePlanner and unifies every new-Mission ingress on the existing async LLM Planner Pool. serve-planner.ts: 'initial' accepts ONLY persisted plan authority (pinned_plan_tasks or metadata.llm_plan) else FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_REQUIRED; PAIR_MC_TEMPLATE_PLANNER and TEMPLATE plan_source removed. business.ts: shared async prepareDelegatedPlan re-derives the canonical bound-mission goal, calls deps.planExpander (same pool as the API edge); FAIL_CLOSED_NO_PLANNER on missing dep, FAIL_CLOSED_DELEGATED_PLAN_ABSENT on empty llm_plan; openWorkItem re-proves the plan goal digest inside the dedup transaction (FAIL_CLOSED_DELEGATED_PLAN_GOAL_DRIFT) and pins llm_plan+provenance on the mission. objective-operating-loop.ts: openDelegatedChild plans after the dispatch proof, re-proves authority+objective CAS post-await, converges in-flight bound missions AWAITING_EXECUTION before the READY gate. mission-draft.ts: confirmInner claims durably then plans via the same expander (missing dep = NO_PLANNER, zero provider calls, retry-safe SUBMITTING). mission-control.ts: tickSchedules requires the expander per due schedule. mission-control-server.ts: /open awaits prepareDelegatedPlan. planner-pool.ts: ONE run-level deadlineMs over eligibility+INITIAL+retries+REASK, FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_DEADLINE with TIMEOUT evidence. cost.ts: planner billing model->executor->UNKNOWN (never FREE), admitPlannerInvocation bound to objective lineage, settle+reconcile from canonical planner_run rows. serve-mission-control.mjs: pool expander wired with cost ctx+deadline, driver/reconcile start deferred until planner deps exist. better-sqlite3 11.10.0->12.11.1: v11 lacks Node 24 support (env-teardown assert crashed every suite worker); no API change. dev-verification: win32 platform baselines registered (verified BASE==HEAD, zero regressions).
